obs: Gilbertville Trucking Co. v. United States

"There is little question that divestiture is within the scope of the Commission's power since, with respect to a 5 (4) violation, it may order any party to 'take such action as may be necessary, in the opinion of the Commission, to prevent continuance of such violation.' 5 (7)."
Sure-Tan, Inc. v. National Labor Relations Board

"the court concluded that a minimum backpay award was necessary to effectuate the purposes of the NLRA"; "the Boards resolute position that reinstatement and back-pay awards are necessary to effectuate the policies of the NLRA"
